But the 'minutes of a UI that reads as hung' consequence is overstated: run-start fires only AFTER load_bars returns (the slow network phase shows 'starting...'), and the engine loop itself is sub-second - an 8-symbol x 5-year run with 10 walk-forward slices completed in 0.82 s - so the frozen 0/N readout is visible for about a second. evidence: src/modules/safety/DisclaimerFlow.tsx:45 (the TOS claim), :47-112 (blocking dialog, mounted at src/app/page.tsx:287-289); src/store/safety.ts:13-16 ('the R9 craft pass removed the kill-switch UI surface, so nothing currently listens for it'); src/modules/index.ts:52-54 ('The kill switch is read-only-... mechanism stays intact and dormant'); src-tauri/src/kill_switch.rs:43-63 + :96; sidecar/services/kill_switch.py:100-160 and sidecar/routers/safety.py:119-143 (both live); grep over src/ finds zero call sites of fireKillSwitch outside src/store/safety.ts and zero listen('kill-switch:requested')

A preset click from Nested mode therefore runs the old tree plus the old formula under the preset's name. resetCriteria and applyFilters both clear these fields, so the preset path is the inconsistent one.
